fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after your visa expires to enter Russia.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe caducar al menos 6 meses después de que venza tu visado para entrar en Rusia.
entry.quote: To enter Russia, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date your visa expires.

entry.en: A visa must be obtained before travelling to Russia.
entry.es: Hay que obtener un visado antes de viajar a Rusia.
entry.quote: You must get a visa before you travel.

entry.en: Foreigners entering Russia must register biometric details such as fingerprints and photographs on arrival.
entry.es: Los extranjeros que entran en Rusia deben registrar al llegar datos biométricos como huellas dactilares y fotografías.
entry.quote: Foreigners entering Russia will be required to register, on arrival, their biometric details such as fingerprints and photographs.

entry.en: You must sign an immigration card at passport control every time you enter Russia.
entry.es: Debes firmar una tarjeta de inmigración en el control de pasaportes cada vez que entres en Rusia.
entry.quote: You must sign an immigration card at passport control every time you enter Russia.

entry.en: Cash and travellers’ cheques can be brought in or out without declaring them if their combined value does not exceed the equivalent of 10,000 US dollars.
entry.es: El efectivo y los cheques de viaje se pueden llevar sin declarar si su valor conjunto no supera el equivalente a 10.000 dólares estadounidenses.
entry.quote: You may bring cash in any currency and travellers’ cheques into or out of Russia without declaring them if their combined value does not exceed the equivalent of 10,000 US dollars.

entry.en: You must register with the local authorities if staying anywhere for more than 7 working days.
entry.es: Debes registrarte ante las autoridades locales si te alojas en un mismo lugar más de 7 días laborables.
entry.quote: You must register with the local authorities if you’re staying anywhere for more than 7 working days.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to Russia because of the risks from its continuing invasion of Ukraine.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a Rusia por los riesgos derivados de su continua invasión de Ucrania.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to Russia

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Russia.
safety.es: Es muy probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Rusia.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Russia.

safety.en: There is an increased risk of British nationals being detained in Russia.
safety.es: Existe un mayor riesgo de que ciudadanos británicos sean detenidos en Rusia.
safety.quote: There is an increased risk of British nationals being detained in Russia

safety.en: Publishing or sharing information considered ‘fake’ or from non-official sources could bring a fine or a prison sentence of up to 15 years.
safety.es: Publicar o difundir información considerada ‘falsa’ o de fuentes no oficiales podría conllevar multa o hasta 15 años de prisión.
safety.quote: If you publish or distribute information considered ‘fake’ or from non-official Russian government sources, you could receive a fine or prison sentence of up to 15 years.

safety.en: Drink spiking, leading to robbery, violence or abuse, can happen.
safety.es: Puede ocurrir que adulteren bebidas, lo que lleva a robos, violencia o abusos.
safety.quote: Drink spiking, leading to robbery, violence or abuse, can happen.

safety.en: British nationals travelling in unregistered taxis have been victims of crime.
safety.es: Ciudadanos británicos que viajaron en taxis no registrados han sido víctimas de delitos.
safety.quote: British nationals travelling in unregistered taxis have been victims of crime.

health.en: Russia has no reciprocal health agreement with the UK.
health.es: Rusia no tiene un acuerdo sanitario recíproco con el Reino Unido.
health.quote: Russia does not have a reciprocal health agreement with the UK.

health.en: Medical care in Russia may not meet western standards.
health.es: La atención médica en Rusia puede no cumplir los estándares occidentales.
health.quote: Medical care may not meet western standards.

health.en: Hospitals do not accept all health cases and may ask for payment before treatment.
health.es: Los hospitales no aceptan todos los casos y pueden pedir el pago antes del tratamiento.
health.quote: Hospitals do not accept all health cases and may request payments before treatment.

health.en: Medication containing narcotic or psychoactive substances requires a prescription in your name, translated into Russian and notarised.
health.es: Los medicamentos con sustancias narcóticas o psicoactivas requieren una receta a tu nombre, traducida al ruso y notarizada.
health.quote: If your medication contains narcotic or psychoactive substances, you must carry a prescription in your name, translated into Russian, and notarised.

health.en: Tap water quality varies around the country and even within cities.
health.es: La calidad del agua del grifo varía según el país e incluso dentro de las ciudades.
health.quote: Quality of tap water varies around the country, and may even be variable within cities.

health.en: Alcoholic drinks containing methanol have caused deaths and serious illness in Russia.
health.es: Bebidas alcohólicas con metanol han causado muertes y enfermedades graves en Rusia.
health.quote: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Russia.

help.en: The emergency number in Russia is 112 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Rusia es el 112 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: British nationals can call the 24-hour helpline +7 495 956 7200 and select the consular services option.
help.es: Los ciudadanos británicos pueden llamar a la línea de ayuda 24 horas +7 495 956 7200 y elegir la opción de servicios consulares.
help.quote: call our 24-hour helpline +7 495 956 7200 and select the option for consular services for British nationals.

help.en: In-person UK government support in Russia is limited.
help.es: La ayuda presencial del gobierno británico en Rusia es limitada.
help.quote: In-person UK government support in Russia is limited.

getting_in.en: Russia has exceptionally onerous visa requirements.
getting_in.es: Rusia tiene requisitos de visado extraordinariamente onerosos.
getting_in.quote: Russia has exceptionally onerous visa requirements.

getting_in.en: Transit through Moscow Sheremetyevo, Moscow Domodedovo or Yekaterinburg Koltsovo airports does not require a transit visa under the conditions the text gives.
getting_in.es: El tránsito por los aeropuertos de Sheremétievo, Domodédovo (Moscú) o Koltsovo (Ekaterimburgo) no requiere visado de tránsito bajo las condiciones indicadas en el texto.
getting_in.quote: Transit through Moscow Sheremetyevo, Moscow Domodedovo or Yekaterinburg Koltsovo airports does not require a transit visa

getting_in.en: You cannot fly directly from Russia to the UK or through EU countries.
getting_in.es: No se puede volar directamente de Rusia al Reino Unido ni a través de países de la UE.
getting_in.quote: You cannot fly directly from Russia to the UK or through EU countries.

getting_around.en: Flying is worth considering for far-off destinations.
getting_around.es: Conviene considerar el avión para destinos lejanos.

getting_around.en: Russia has an extensive rail network linking nearly every city and town.
getting_around.es: Rusia tiene una extensa red ferroviaria que une casi todas las ciudades y pueblos.
getting_around.quote: Russia has an extensive rail network linking nearly every city and town.

getting_around.en: Yandex.Go is described as the most popular taxi app in Russia and works in most cities.
getting_around.es: Yandex.Go se describe como la aplicación de taxi más popular de Rusia y funciona en la mayoría de ciudades.
getting_around.quote: Yandex.Go - the most popular taxi mobile app in Russia and functions in majority of cities across the country.

getting_around.en: Google Maps and Apple Maps may be outdated and unreliable in Russia due to Western sanctions.
getting_around.es: Google Maps y Apple Maps pueden estar desactualizados y no ser fiables en Rusia por las sanciones occidentales.
getting_around.quote: Due to Western sanctions on Russia, Google Maps and Apple Maps may be outdated and unreliable.

getting_around.en: Do not flag down a taxi or share one with strangers.
getting_around.es: No pares un taxi en la calle ni compartas uno con desconocidos.
getting_around.quote: Do not flag down a taxi or share a taxi with strangers.

money.en: Mastercard and Visa cards issued outside Russia will not work at Russian shops or ATMs.
money.es: Las tarjetas Mastercard y Visa emitidas fuera de Rusia no funcionan en tiendas ni cajeros rusos.
money.quote: Mastercard and Visa cards issued outside Russia will not work at Russian shops or ATMs.

money.en: Paying directly for general transactions in foreign currency is illegal in Russia.
money.es: Pagar directamente en moneda extranjera en transacciones generales es ilegal en Rusia.
money.quote: It is illegal to pay directly for general transactions in Russia using foreign currency.

money.en: Money should only be changed at banks, hotels and exchange bureaus, and changing money from street traders is illegal.
money.es: El dinero solo debe cambiarse en bancos, hoteles y casas de cambio, y cambiarlo con vendedores callejeros es ilegal.
money.quote: Only change money at banks, hotels and exchange bureaus. It is illegal to change money from street traders.

money.en: Tipping is described as not necessary but expected, and a tip above 10% would be unusual.
money.es: Se describe la propina como no necesaria pero esperada, y una propina superior al 10% sería inusual.
money.quote: Tipping is not necessary, but expected. A tip exceeding 10% would be unusual.

money.en: Tipping is not considered customary for taxis.
money.es: No es costumbre dar propina a los taxistas.
money.quote: Tipping is not considered customary for taxis

money.en: Russian ATMs often have a withdrawal limit of around 100,000 to 150,000 rubles per day.
money.es: Los cajeros rusos suelen tener un límite de retiro de unos 100.000 a 150.000 rublos al día.
money.quote: Russian ATMs often have a withdrawal limit of around 100,000—150,000 руб. per day.

etiquette.en: Smiling is traditionally reserved for friends and close acquaintances.
etiquette.es: Tradicionalmente la sonrisa se reserva para amigos y conocidos cercanos.
etiquette.quote: Smiling is traditionally reserved for friends and close acquaintances.

etiquette.en: Russians are generally reserved and well-mannered, and tend to be more traditional than other Europeans.
etiquette.es: Los rusos suelen ser reservados y educados, y tienden a ser más tradicionales que otros europeos.
etiquette.quote: Russians are generally reserved and well-mannered, and tend to be more traditional than other Europeans.

etiquette.en: Public drunkenness is frowned upon in Russia.
etiquette.es: La embriaguez en público está mal vista en Rusia.
etiquette.quote: Despite stereotypes, public drunkenness is frowned upon in Russia.

etiquette.en: Political discourse is described as incredibly sensitive.
etiquette.es: El discurso político se describe como extremadamente delicado.

connectivity.en: Some social networks and apps are blocked, but this is described as easily circumvented with VPN apps.
connectivity.es: Algunas redes sociales y aplicaciones están bloqueadas, pero se describe que es fácil sortearlo con aplicaciones VPN.
connectivity.quote: Some social networks and applications like ones outlined above are blocked, but this is easily circumvented by using VPN apps

connectivity.en: Free Wi-Fi often requires a Russian phone number to register.
connectivity.es: El wifi gratuito a menudo exige un número de teléfono ruso para registrarse.
connectivity.quote: Often you still simply need a Russian phone number and you can register at free Wi-Fi

connectivity.en: The five main mobile operators are Beeline, Megafon, MTS, T2 and Yota.
connectivity.es: Los cinco operadores móviles principales son Beeline, Megafon, MTS, T2 y Yota.
connectivity.quote: There are five main mobile operators in Russia: Beeline, Megafon, MTS, T2, and Yota.

connectivity.en: Telegram is described as the most popular messaging app in Russia.
connectivity.es: Telegram se describe como la aplicación de mensajería más popular de Rusia.
connectivity.quote: Telegram - most popular messaging app in Russia nowadays
